not_proven: Real Feishu connection or signature verification
Project RPC authentication or Agent request
Old Binding stop, Project Gateway start, or authenticated WebSocket count
Live single-consumer cutover, state restoration, rollback RTO/RPO or real message reconciliation

findings.title: Card analysis request bypasses durable two-message reply intent
findings.risk: A card becomes a parallel analysis-intent path without real reply target, requester message, text intent or durable analysis_request.json admission.
findings.required_disposition: Route analysis only from signed later text with reply_to_message_id; OpenClaw must create the sole durable analysis request.

findings.title: Single-consumer lease/verifier is neither runtime-integrated nor atomic
findings.risk: Caller-supplied snapshots and an unfenced read/write lease cannot prove Binding shutdown, exclusive Project ownership or prevent split-brain.
findings.required_disposition: Integrate a fenced atomic ownership control into shutdown/startup and independently observe live authenticated consumer ownership.

findings.title: Validated Gateway envelope has no implemented idempotent adapter to audited RPC client
findings.risk: Client message API omits complete card/text context and retries ambiguous agent calls with a new request UUID.
findings.required_disposition: Implement a narrow policy-validated adapter with durable correlation/idempotency and reconciliation of ambiguous delivery.

findings.title: Migration, state restoration and rollback are simulations rather than recoverable procedure
findings.risk: No loss boundary, duplicate reconciliation, transactional state restore or RTO/RPO proof exists.
findings.required_disposition: Add drain, transactional state/outbox, restore hash proof, replay reconciliation and measured controlled rehearsal.

findings.title: General reports and Git history lack enforceable redaction proof
findings.risk: Runtime paths are ignored but generic reports are trackable and the unborn branch provides no history proof.
findings.required_disposition: Enforce report and diagnostic redaction before staging.

findings.title: Lifecycle health does not attest process identity or consumer owner
findings.risk: PID/status health can be stale or unrelated to active consumer ownership.
findings.required_disposition: Bind readiness to process identity, consumer fence and safe event/queue metrics.

findings.title: Multi-channel and durable product work are not yet modeled
findings.risk: Feishu-specific routing has no normalized channel/account adapter, durable queue, GPU scheduler or extensible Analyzer registry.
findings.required_disposition: Keep Gateway compute-free and add normalized durable OpenClaw-owned work in later authorized phases.

findings.title: RPC session-creation documentation conflicts with implementation
findings.risk: Operators may assume a sessions.create path exists though client code returns method not allowed.
findings.required_disposition: Document implicit session semantics or remove conflicting acceptance wording.

findings.title: Offline fixture acknowledges event before downstream completion
findings.risk: If copied into a live adapter, transient failure could be marked duplicate on redelivery.
findings.required_disposition: Keep fixture-only or align acknowledgement ordering with ProjectFeishuGateway.

required_before_architecture_ready_for_r: Eliminate card-originated analysis intent in favor of reply_to_message_id-bound durable requests.
Implement atomic fenced runtime-integrated single-consumer ownership and independently observe it.
Implement Gateway-to-RPC envelope adapter with durable idempotency and correlation.
Prove drain, restore, replay reconciliation and rollback RTO/RPO in a controlled authorized rehearsal.
Add report-redaction enforcement and lifecycle owner/lease observability.
